# Boosteroid Optimizer Plus

> Free, open-source (MIT) userscript for Tampermonkey or Violentmonkey that improves image quality, resolution and latency in the Boosteroid cloud gaming web player. Current stable version: 6.1.1. Author: Derfog. Not an official Boosteroid product.

## Key facts

- What it is: a browser userscript that runs only on boosteroid.com, client-side. No account, no data collection.
- Price and license: free, MIT license, source on GitHub.
- Requirements: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera or Firefox; Tampermonkey or Violentmonkey; a Boosteroid subscription. WebGPU features need Chrome or Edge 113+.
- Install: install Tampermonkey, open https://raw.githubusercontent.com/optimizerplus/optimizer-plus/main/Boosteroid-Optimizer-Plus.user.js and confirm, then start a game on Boosteroid and open the in-game menu. Updates install automatically.
- Interface languages (15): English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Polish, Ukrainian, Turkish, Czech, Hungarian, Romanian, Slovak, Swedish.

## Features

- Resolution: native, 4K and ultrawide (21:9, 32:9), matched to the resolutions the Boosteroid server accepts.
- Codec: AV1 when the GPU decodes it in hardware, HEVC or H.264 otherwise.
- Upscaling: AMD FSR 1 (EASU + RCAS) when the stream is smaller than the screen.
- Image filters: sharpening, denoise, deband, clarity, vibrance; presets Cinematic, Competitive, Comfort, Perfect Quality.
- Rendering: WebGPU in a worker on Chrome and Edge so mouse input never stalls the video; WebGL2 fallback elsewhere.
- Network: higher receive ceiling, packet retransmission and a tuned jitter buffer; the bitrate is never forced.
- 120 FPS available on every screen.
- Display: stretch mode without black borders, performance mode for weaker GPUs.
